gpus.basis: Memory bandwidth and dense 16-bit (BF16) tensor throughput per GPU from NVIDIA's product pages. NVIDIA quotes most tensor figures with sparsity; dense is half, as each page's footnote states. Where a figure is missing the throughput estimate needs your own value.

specs.note: Page lists 242 TFLOPS with sparsity and states dense is one-half.
Half the 1,979 TFLOPS listed with sparsity.
94 GB variant; half the 1,671 TFLOPS listed with sparsity.
SXM; half the 1,979 TFLOPS listed with sparsity. NVIDIA marks the specifications preliminary.
HGX B200 lists 36 PFLOPS with sparsity per 8 GPUs; memory bandwidth is not stated on the page.
HGX B300 lists 36 PFLOPS with sparsity per 8 GPUs; memory bandwidth is not stated on the page.
GB200 NVL72 rack figures (576 TB/s, 360 PFLOPS with sparsity) divided by 72 GPUs.
GB300 NVL72 rack figures (up to 576 TB/s, 360 PFLOPS with sparsity) divided by 72 GPUs.

The page lists 1 PFLOP for FP16/BF16 without saying whether it includes sparsity. Half of it (500 TFLOPS) is used, so if the listed figure is dense the estimate overstates prefill time and cost. Fractional Azure slices have no published bandwidth share.
